title: Ziyarat of Ibrahim al-Mujab
intro: The visitation of Sayyid Ibrahim al-Mujab, whose shrine is within the Imam Husayn shrine complex.
description: Read Ziyarat of Ibrahim al-Mujab with arabic text, transliteration and english meaning, recitation context and source references.

blocks.arabic: السَّلاٰمُ عَلَيْكَ أَيُّهَا السَّيِّدُ الزَّكِيُّ الطّٰاهِرُ الْوَلِيُّ
blocks.transliteration: As-salāmu ʿalayka ayyuhā as-sayyidu az-zakiyyut ṭāhirul walī
blocks.english: Peace be upon you, O pure, immaculate master, the guardian,

blocks.arabic: الدّٰاعِي الْحَفِيّ،
blocks.transliteration: Ad-dāʿil ḥafiyy
blocks.english: The modest caller,

blocks.arabic: أَشْهَدُ أَنَّكَ قُلْتَ حَقّاً،
blocks.transliteration: Ashhadu annaka qulta ḥaqqan
blocks.english: I bear witness that you spoke the truth,

blocks.arabic: وَنَطَقْتَ صِدْقاً،
blocks.transliteration: Wa nāṭaqta ṣidqan
blocks.english: And uttered sincerely,

blocks.arabic: وَدَعَوْتَ إِلَىٰ مَوْلَايَ وَمَوْلَاكَ الْحُسَيْنِ عليه السلام عَلانِيَةً وَسِرّاً،
blocks.transliteration: Wa da‘awta ilā mawlāya wa mawlāka al-Ḥusayn ʿalayhi as-salām ʿalāniyatan wa sirran
blocks.english: And called openly and secretly to my master and your master, Al-Husayn, peace be upon him.

blocks.arabic: فَازَ مُتَّبِعُكَ، وَنَجَا مُصَدِّقُكَ،
blocks.transliteration: Fāza muttabiʿuka, wa najā muṣaddiquka
blocks.english: Your follower succeeded, and your verifier was saved,

blocks.arabic: ي وَابْنَ سَيِّدِي وَيَا مَوْلَايَ وَابْنَ مَوْلَايَ
blocks.transliteration: Yā ibn sayyidī wa yā mawlāya wa ibn mawlāya
blocks.english: O son of my master and O my master and son of my master,

blocks.arabic: وَخَابَ وَخَسِرَ مُكَذِّبُكَ، وَالْمُتَخَلِّفُ عَنْكَ يَا سَيِّدِ
blocks.transliteration: Wa khāba wa khasira mukadhdhibuka, wal-mutakhallifu ʿanka yā sayyid
blocks.english: Cursed and lost is your denier, and the one who lags behind you, O master.

blocks.arabic: أَشْهَدْ لِي بِهٰذِهِ الشَّهَادَةِ عِنْدَكَ،
blocks.transliteration: Ashhad lī bihādhihi ash-shahādati ʿindaka
blocks.english: Bear witness for me with this testimony before you,

blocks.arabic: لِأَكُونَ مِنَ الْفَائِزِينَ بِمَعْرِفَتِكَ وَطَاعَتِكَ
blocks.transliteration: Li-akūna mina al-fā’izīna bimaʿrifatika wa ṭāʿatika
blocks.english: That I may be among the successful by knowing you and obeying you,

blocks.arabic: وَتَصْدِيقِكَ وَاتِّبَاعِكَ،
blocks.transliteration: Wa taṣdīqika wa ittiʿābika
blocks.english: And affirming you and following you.

blocks.arabic: وَالسَّلَامُ عَلَيْكَ يَا سَيِّدِي وَابْنَ سَيِّدِي وَيَا مَوْلاَيَ وَابْنَ مَوْلاَيَ
blocks.transliteration: Wa as-salāmu ʿalayka yā sayyidī wa ibn sayyidī wa yā mawlay wa ibn mawlay
blocks.english: And peace be upon you, O my master and son of my master and O my master and son of my master.

blocks.arabic: يَا سَيِّدُ إِبْرَاهِيمُ الْمُجَابُ ابْنُ الْمُحَمَّدِ الْعَابِدِ بْنِ الإِمَامِ مُوسَى بْنِ جَعْفَرٍ عليه السلام وَرَحْمَةُ اللّٰهِ وَبَرَكَاتُهُ
blocks.transliteration: Yā sayyid Ibrāhīm al-mujāb ibn al-Muḥammad al-ʿābid ibn al-Imām Mūsā ibn Jaʿfar ʿalayhimu as-salām wa raḥmatullāhi wa barakātuhu
blocks.english: O master Ibrahim Al-Mujab, son of Muhammad the worshipper, son of Imam Musa ibn Ja'far, peace be upon them, and God's mercy and blessings.

blocks.arabic: اشْهَدْ لِي بِهٰذِهِ الشَّهَادَةِ لِأَكُونَ مِنَ الْفَائِزِينَ بِمَعْرِفَتِكَ وَطَاعَتِكَ وَتَصْدِيقِكَ وَاتِّبَاعِكَ الصَّلَاةُ
blocks.transliteration: Ashhad lī bihādhihi ash-shahādati li-akūna mina al-fā’izīna bimaʿrifatika wa ṭāʿatika wa taṣdīqika wa ittiʿābika aṣ-ṣalāh
blocks.english: Bear witness for me with this testimony that I may be among the successful by knowing you, obeying you, affirming you, and following you in prayer.

blocks.arabic:
السَّلاٰمُ‌ عَلَيكَ‌ أَيُّهَا السَّيِّدُ الزَّكِيُّ‌
الطّٰاهِرُ الْوَلِيُّ‌
blocks.transliteration: Al salamo alaika aiohal sayedal zaki Attahiral wali
blocks.english: Peace be upon you, O pious master,pure saint,

blocks.arabic: الدّٰاعِي الْحَفِيّ‌،
blocks.transliteration: Wadda’ial hafi
blocks.english: and generous caller.

blocks.arabic: أَشْهَدُ أَنَّكَ‌ قُلْتَ‌ حَقّاً،
blocks.transliteration: Ashhado anaka qolta haqqa
blocks.english: I bear witness that you said the truth,

blocks.arabic: وَنَطَقْتَ‌ صِدْقاً،
blocks.transliteration: Wa nataqta haqqan wa sidqan
blocks.english: and spoke the truth rightfully.

blocks.arabic: وَدَعَوْتَ‌ إلىٰ‌ مَوْلاٰيَ‌ وَمَولاٰكَ‌ الْحُسَينِ‌ عليه السلام عَلاٰنِيَةً‌ وَسِرّاً،
blocks.transliteration: Wa da’awta ela mawlaia wa mawlaka ‘alaneiatan wa seran
blocks.english: And called for my master and yours publicly and secretly.

blocks.arabic: فٰازَ مُتَّبِعُكَ‌، وَنَجٰا مُصَدِّقُكَ‌،
blocks.transliteration: Faza mut-tabe’ok wa naja mosadeqok
blocks.english: Won who followed you, and survived who believed in you.

blocks.arabic:
ي وَابْنَ‌ سَيِّدِي وَيٰا مَولاٰيَ‌ وَابْنَ‌ مَوْلاٰيَ
‌ وَخٰابَ‌ وَخَسِرَ مُكَذِّبُكَ‌، وَالْمُتَخَلِّفُ‌ عَنْكَ‌ يٰا سَيِّدِ
blocks.transliteration: Wa khaba wa khasira mokazibok walmotkhalifo ank
blocks.english: Disappointed and lost who denied you , and fall behind you.

blocks.arabic: اَشهد لي بهذهِ الشهادةِ عندكَ,
blocks.transliteration: Eshad le behazihil shadati ‘endaka
blocks.english: Bear witness to me this testimony next to you

blocks.arabic: لأكونَ منَ الفائزينَ بمعرفتِكَ و طاعتِكَ
blocks.transliteration: Le akona mena alfaezeen be ma’refateka wa ta’ateka
blocks.english: So I could be one of the winners of knowing you, and obeying you,

blocks.arabic: وَ تصديقِكَ واتِّباعكَ,
blocks.transliteration: Wa tasdeqaka wa etteba’aka
blocks.english: believing you, and following you.

blocks.arabic: وَالسَّلاٰمُ‌ عَلَيْكَ‌ يٰا سَيِّدِي وَابْنَ‌ سَيِّدِي وَيٰا مَوْلاٰيَ‌ وَابْنَ‌ مَوْلاٰيَ‌
blocks.transliteration: Wassalamo alaika ya mawlaia wabna mawlaia
blocks.english: And peace be upon you, o my master, and the son of my master,

blocks.arabic: يٰا سَيِّدُ ابْرٰاهيِمُ‌ الْمُجابُ‌ ابْنُ‌ الْمُحَمَّدٍ الْعٰابِدِ بْن الإِمٰامِ‌ مُوسَى بْنِ‌ جَعْفَرٍ عليه السلام وَرَحْمَةُ‌ اللّٰهِ‌ وَبَرَكٰاتُهُ‌».
blocks.transliteration: Ya sayed Ibrahim almujaab ibna mohamadenl ‘aabid Ibni alemami musa bena ja’far wa rahmato-llahi wa barakatoh
blocks.english: O sayed Ibrahim Almujab, son of Mohammed Al-‘Abid,son of Imam Musa, the son of Ja’far, and also mercy and benedictions of Allah

urduGuidance: یہ صفحہ زیارت سید ابراہیم مجاب کے لیے ہے۔ عربی متن اصل قراءت کے لیے ہے اور رومن تلفظ پڑھنے میں مدد دیتا ہے۔ انگریزی معنی الگ درج ہیں۔ ماخذ اور دوسری زیارات کے روابط صفحے کے آخر میں دیے گئے ہیں۔
